description: Backend: `failed` Run status + migration 0002, run_id grammar validator, duplicate run_id -> 400 including the unique-index IntegrityError race, PATCH status=failed|awaiting_review gated to `running` via apply_status_transition (apply_decision-style conditional atomic update, 409 otherwise), RunUpdateSerializer.update writes only named fields, carried item 6(a) docstring, docstring rewrites, backend/README.md lifecycle note, and all backend tests. Implements batch2-plan.md items 1-5 and design D1, D2, D4, D5, §4.1, §6. Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level (the CLI only talks HTTP), but ordered first so the CLI contract exists.
steps: Before-behaviour facts to record in findings (already verified): POST /api/runs/ accepts a client run_id with only length<=64 + uniqueness checks; sequential duplicate -> 400 {"run_id": ["run with this run id already exists."]}; concurrent duplicate -> IntegrityError -> 500; running->awaiting_review is written nowhere (only docstrings in RunUpdateSerializer and backend/tasks/scheduled.py:193); PATCH accepts any status choice.
Start the Mongo replica set per context.json verification_instructions (port 27018) and export both URLs. Leave the container running for later steps.

backend/runs/models.py: add ("failed", "failed") after submitted in STATUS_CHOICES; 'five values' comment -> six with the failed explanation; Run docstring clause 'or marked `failed` by the CLI on any error after registration' (design §4.1).

Run `cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py makemigrations runs` -> backend/runs/migrations/0002_alter_run_status.py; diff its body (from `from django.db import` onward) against the block pinned in design §4.1; it must match. Fallback if Mongo cannot be started: hand-write it with header `# Generated by Django 5.2.18 on <date>` and record that in findings.

backend/runs/serializers.py per design D2/D4/§4.1/6(a): add RUN_ID_PATTERN and RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE (with the pinned comment and the comment pointing at cli/vaultshield/run_directory._RUN_ID_PATTERN); RunSerializer.Meta.extra_kwargs run_id validators = [RegexValidator(RUN_ID_PATTERN, message="run_id must be 1-64 characters: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, `-` or `_`."), UniqueValidator(queryset=Run.objects.all(), message=RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE)]; rewrite '### run_id format is not validated here' -> '### run_id format'; five -> six in status bullets; RunUpdateSerializer docstring gated paragraph replacing the 'no transition restriction' bullet; add RunUpdateSerializer.update override (setattr each validated field; instance.save(update_fields=[*validated_data, "updated_at"])) with a Requirement 12.4 docstring; replace FileDiffStatSerializer patch_truncated paragraph with the §4.1 6(a) text and fix the allow_blank bullet.

backend/runs/views.py per design D4/D5: StateTransitionError.__init__(current_status, *, recorded_decision=None, target=None, allowed=()) with the TypeError mutual-exclusion check as the first statement, message built from `allowed` when target is given, unchanged text when target is None; class docstring wording; GATED_PATCH_TRANSITIONS dict and apply_status_transition(run, target, other_fields) exactly as D4; RunViewSet.partial_update override with the exact D4 body; RunViewSet.perform_create wrapping serializer.save() in try/except django.db.IntegrityError -> ValidationError({"run_id": [RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE]}) only when Run.objects.filter(run_id=serializer.validated_data["run_id"]).exists(), else re-raise; Requirement-tagged docstrings on every new function; rewrite the RunViewSet run_id note, apply_decision re-open paragraph, module docstring table rows. No logic change to diff/events/screenshots/apply_decision.

backend/tasks/scheduled.py docstrings only: :86-90 stale-status list gains `failed`; :94-95 append that an error the CLI survives now ends in `failed`; :193 chain -> `running -> awaiting_review | failed -> approved/rejected -> submitted`.

backend/runs/tests.py (DB-free): STATUS_CHOICES contains failed; RunSerializer().fields['run_id'] validators include a RegexValidator with RUN_ID_PATTERN and a UniqueValidator whose message is RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE; GATED_PATCH_TRANSITIONS == {'awaiting_review': frozenset({'running'}), 'failed': frozenset({'running'})}; StateTransitionError('running', recorded_decision='approved', target='failed') raises TypeError; target message text names `failed`, `running` and the current status.

backend/vaultshield_backend/test_mongodb.py: new TestRunStatusTransitions (@pytest.mark.django_db) via the API client — PATCH failed and PATCH awaiting_review from running -> 200, stored, updated_at stored == returned (as TestApprovalAtomicity.test_updated_at_is_stored_exactly_as_returned); from awaiting_review/approved/rejected/submitted/failed -> 409 with current_status == stored and row (status, pr_url, updated_at) unchanged; approve/reject on running and failed -> 409, on awaiting_review -> 200; D4 stale-status pr_url test (load instance, Run.objects.filter(pk=...).update(status='failed'), RunUpdateSerializer(instance, data={'pr_url': ...}, partial=True).save(), stored status still failed). New TestConcurrentStatusTransitions (@pytest.mark.django_db(transaction=True)) reusing TestConcurrentSequenceAllocation._run_workers' Barrier/ThreadPoolExecutor/connections.close_all() shape: two threads call apply_status_transition('failed') vs ('awaiting_review') on separate fresh Run.objects.get, 20 iterations, exactly one success + one StateTransitionError, no other exception, stored status == winner's target. In TestRestApiAgainstMongoDB: sequential duplicate body == {'run_id': ['run with this run id already exists.']}; race via patch.object(rest_framework.validators.UniqueValidator, '__call__', return_value=None) -> 400 same body and exactly one stored Run; acceptance 7 format cases ('a/b', 'a.b', '-x', '', 65 chars -> 400 with run_id key; '20260903-195802-e503f16521bb1a9c', '20240101-000000-abc' -> 201).

backend/README.md: append a short 'Run lifecycle' note per design §4.1/§4.7/§7 item 10 (running -> awaiting_review by CLI completion PATCH | failed by CLI on error; approve/reject only from awaiting_review; failed terminal; gated PATCH 409; residual stuck-running cases: SIGKILL/power loss, lost create_run response, Ctrl-C during registration; reaper is a follow-up). Build on the existing uncommitted README content.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run` prints 'No changes detected' and 0002_alter_run_status.py matches the §4.1 pinned body from `from django.db import` onward
Full backend `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes against the replica set, including every new test named in the steps and the pre-existing test_patch_writes_back_a_pr_url
verification: cd /Users/aayush/Codes/VaultShield/backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run && .venv/bin/python manage.py check (URLs exported to the replica set)
cd /Users/aayush/Codes/VaultShield/backend && .venv/bin/pytest -q (URLs exported to the replica set); record pass/fail counts in findings
findings:
BEFORE-BEHAVIOUR (verified at planning, unchanged by re-reading the code): POST /api/runs/ already took a client-supplied run_id (required writable RunSerializer field) with only length<=64 + uniqueness checks and no format check; sequential duplicate -> 400 {"run_id": ["run with this run id already exists."]} (DRF-derived UniqueValidator); concurrent duplicate -> unique-index IntegrityError -> unhandled 500; running->awaiting_review was written NOWHERE (backend or CLI), only claimed in docstrings (RunUpdateSerializer, tasks/scheduled.py:193); PATCH accepted any status choice with no transition rule; create may set any status; authz token-only, no owner model (flagged, unchanged).

WHAT CHANGED (backend/ only): models.py `failed` 6th choice + comment/docstring; migration 0002 (see below); serializers.py RUN_ID_PATTERN + RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE constants, RunSerializer.Meta.extra_kwargs run_id validators [RegexValidator(pinned message), UniqueValidator(message=RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE)], '### run_id format' rewrite, five->six, RunUpdateSerializer gated-transition docstring + update() override saving update_fields=[*validated_data,'updated_at'] (Requirement 12.4 docstring), 6(a) FileDiffStatSerializer patch_truncated paragraph replaced with the §4.1 text and allow_blank bullet fixed; views.py StateTransitionError(target=, allowed=) with first-statement TypeError mutual-exclusion and target message built from `allowed` (target=None text byte-identical), GATED_PATCH_TRANSITIONS, apply_status_transition (retry_on_transient_transaction_error + django_mongodb_backend atomic + conditional filter(...).update(status, updated_at=to_mongo_precision(now), **other_fields); only cosmetic deviation from D4: the table entry is bound to a local `allowed` once), RunViewSet.partial_update (exact D4 body) and perform_create (IntegrityError -> ValidationError({'run_id':[RUN_ID_UNIQUE_MESSAGE]}) only if Run.objects.filter(run_id=...).exists(), else re-raise), docstring rewrites (module table rows, StateTransitionError class line, apply_decision re-open paragraph now names the two-step PATCH running -> PATCH awaiting_review route, RunViewSet run_id note). tasks/scheduled.py docstrings only (stale list gains `failed`; survived-error-ends-in-failed sentence; lifecycle chain). backend/README.md: appended '## Run lifecycle' section (gated PATCH 409, approve/reject only from awaiting_review, failed terminal, backend never moves a Run itself / diff ingest does not complete it, run_id grammar + duplicate 400, residual stuck-running cases SIGKILL/power loss, lost create_run response, Ctrl-C during registration, reaper follow-up). Also corrected the pre-existing uncommitted README sentence that said patch_truncated means 'only a prefix' to the 6(a) wider meaning (same fact as the serializer docstring). No logic change to diff/events/screenshots/apply_decision; security_scan/rules.py untouched (`git diff --quiet` passes).

ENVIRONMENT NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: Docker Desktop was wedged (backend up ~8h with its VM gone: 'no route to host 192.168.65.7:2376', no com.docker.virtualization process), so I quit it (osascript quit app "Docker") and re-opened it; it came up in ~55s. That auto-restarted the unrelated ipsakti-* containers (ipsakti-mongo holds 27017) — not touched otherwise. vs-test-mongo is RUNNING on 27018 as replica set rs0 (PRIMARY), left up for later steps; the final step should `docker stop vs-test-mongo` (started with --rm).

FOR FEAT-002 / REVIEWER: (1) The CLI contract is live: POST /api/runs/ {project, run_id, agent} -> 201 (status defaults to running; run_id must match \A[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}\Z); PATCH /api/runs/<id>/ {status: awaiting_review|failed} -> 200 from running, else 409 {detail: 'A Run can only move to `<target>` from `running`; this Run is `<current>`.', current_status}. Duplicate run_id -> 400 {run_id: [...]}; unknown/invalid project -> 400 {project: [...]}. (2) DRF runs every field validator even after one fails, so a malformed run_id still reaches the UniqueValidator query; a DB-free serializer test for bad run_ids is therefore impossible, and those cases live in test_mongodb.py (the DB-free tests assert the declared validators and the regex itself). (3) Flagged and unchanged per design: running/approved/rejected/submitted remain settable by PATCH from anything (e.g. PATCH running revives a failed Run); create can still set any status; no owner authz. (4) partial_update's non-gated branch copies UpdateModelMixin.update's tail per D4 and so omits DRF's `_prefetched_objects_cache` reset; RunViewSet never prefetches, so this is not observable.
